name: Himeno Akari
source:
[b]A Surprisingly Tomboyish・Comforting Classmate[/b]

Zodiac: Taurus

[url=/c133874]Yui[/url]'s classmate at Acacia Academy who also shares a room with him in the dormitory. She is honest and cheerful, but performs a bit poorly at both academics and sports. Like all feminists in this society of women, she has a vague hatred and fear of men. She appears to be coming from a complicated family......
